values.note: Dutchess County Parks' online reservation system, or by phone at 845-298-4600 (Mon-Fri 8:30-4:30, credit card only). Advance registration is required and walk-in camping is not allowed; bring the permit. Resident rates need proof of a Dutchess County street address.

booking.source: https://www.dutchessny.gov/Departments/Parks/Wilcox-Park.htm ('Camping- Advance Registration is required ... Registered campers must bring approved permit with them. WALK-IN CAMPING is not allowed. Please call park office at 845-298-4600 Monday - Friday, 8:30am-4:30pm or explore campground and pavilion availability online'; 'Credit card payments only') + https://www.dutchessny.gov/Departments/Parks/Park-Fee-Schedules.htm ('Reservations can be made online or over the phone by calling 845-298-4600'; 'proof of Dutchess County Residence required - A PO BOX is not considered proof of residency'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.dutchessny.gov/Departments/Parks/Park-Fee-Schedules.htm ('RV SITES 1 - 10 ... Electric (30 amp) & Water - Dump Station'; 'TENT SITES 11-27 : No water - no electric'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 10 water-and-electric sites (1-10) strictly for RVs and trailers, one of them a handicapped-accessible platform; 17 tent sites (11-27), walk-in or drive-up.

sites.source: https://www.dutchessny.gov/Departments/Parks/Wilcox-Park.htm ('27 Camp Sites (10 RV & 17 Tent)') + https://www.dutchessny.gov/Departments/Parks/Park-Fee-Schedules.htm ('RV SITES 1 - 10 are strictly for RV's & trailers ONLY - no tenting reservations are allowed on these sites') + https://www.dutchessny.gov/Departments/Parks/Docs/Forest-Acres-Campground-Map.pdf (legend: Water & Electric RV Campsites 1-9, Water & Electric RV Platform Campsite 10; Primitive Walk-In 11-19, Primitive Drive-Up 20-27), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.dutchessny.gov/Departments/Parks/Park-Fee-Schedules.htm ('Electric (30 amp) & Water - Dump Station') + https://www.dutchessny.gov/Departments/Parks/Docs/Forest-Acres-Campground-Map.pdf (Bath house, Showers, Dumping Station marked), read 2026-10-21

note: Dutchess County park (Milan): Forest Acres Campground, open May-Sep, near the park's swimming, boating and fishing lakes. --Claude
summary: Dutchess County pages: confirmed $30 resident / $35 non-resident for the RV sites, 27 sites (10 RV + 17 tent), water at the RV sites, advance registration with no walk-ins, phone 845-758-6100. Added electric 30 amp, showers, dump, online/phone booking (county ParkReservations). Not stated: season dates beyond 'Opens in early May', max rig length, booking window.
